def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def singleton_runs(signatures):
        positions = []
        start = 0
        while start < len(signatures):
            end = start + 1
            while end < len(signatures) and signatures[end] == signatures[start]:
                end += 1
            if end - start == 1:
                positions.append(start)
            start = end
        return positions

    rows = singleton_runs([tuple(row) for row in grid])
    cols = singleton_runs([tuple(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)])

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        outrow = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            color = corners[0]
            outrow.append(color if color != 0 and all(x == color for x in corners) else 0)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(w)
    ]

    common_row_mode = Counter(row_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]
    common_col_mode = Counter(col_modes).most_common(1)[0][0]

    horizontal = [r for r, mode in enumerate(row_modes) if mode != common_row_mode]
    vertical = [c for c, mode in enumerate(col_modes) if mode != common_col_mode]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(horizontal) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(vertical) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[horizontal[i]][vertical[j]],
                grid[horizontal[i]][vertical[j + 1]],
                grid[horizontal[i + 1]][vertical[j]],
                grid[horizontal[i + 1]][vertical[j + 1]],
            ]
            value = corners[0]
            row.append(value if value != 0 and all(x == value for x in corners) else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        for c in range(w)
    ]

    # Grid lines have a different dominant color from the repeated interior rows/columns.
    row_mode = Counter(row_modes).most_common()[-1][0]
    col_mode = Counter(col_modes).most_common()[-1][0]
    rows = [r for r, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value == row_mode]
    cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value == col_mode]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            color = corners[0]
            out_row.append(color if color != 0 and all(x == color for x in corners) else 0)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
